def transform(df):
    df = df.dropna(subset=["fare_amount", "passenger_count"])
    df = df[df["fare_amount"] > 0]
    df = df[df["passenger_count"] > 0]
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    df["fare_per_mile"] = df["fare_amount"] / df["trip_distance"]
    return df
